invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata object, as it is constructed and returned immediately.
Write statuses are expected to be present in the write metadata and should never be null.
instantTime is typically required and should be non-null and non-empty for any write operation.
preppedRecords is expected to be non-null for a bulk insert operation.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is required to execute the bulk insert operation.
